question: Which of the following has a tetragonal crystal system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcium sulphate.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In a tetragonal crystal system**:

 
 
• **a=b****≠c **
 
• **α = β = γ = 90⁰**
 
 
 
• **​Calcium Sulphate**__: It is a** calcium compound with the formula CaSO4 and its related hydrates.** ​
 
 
• ​**Uses** 
 
 
• ​Its major use is in the manufacture of Plaster of Paris.
 
• It is used in tofu as a coagulant.
 
• The compound was used to make sulphuric acid before the 1970s.
 
• It is used as a moisture indicator.
